name: Image
overview: Scripture reveals that humanity is uniquely created in the image and likeness of God, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27 and Genesis 5:1, establishing mankind’s distinct role and dignity in creation. This divine image carries moral and spiritual significance, underscored by Genesis 9:6 which links the sanctity of human life to being made in God's image. The concept extends beyond physical likeness to include relational and righteous communion with God, reflected in Psalms 17:15 where the psalmist longs to awaken satisfied in God's likeness. Additionally, Ezekiel 8:3 introduces the idea of an 'image of jealousy,' illustrating the spiritual dangers of idolatry and misplaced devotion, contrasting the true image of God in man.
